scripts.pack: pnpm run check && pnpm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const v=fs.readFileSync('theme.yaml','utf8').match(/^  version:\s*\"([^\"]+)\"/m)?.[1]||'release';const out='dist/theme-mote-'+v+'.zip';fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});fs.rmSync(out,{force:true});cp.execFileSync('zip',['-rq',out,'theme.yaml','settings.yaml','annotation-setting.yaml','README.md','templates'],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Packed:',out,(fs.statSync(out).size/1024).toFixed(1)+'KB');"
